name: no-rollback
mirrors: Install.ts applyShim: drop the catch on fs.rename(nextShim, paths.shimAsar), so a failed rename no longer puts _app.asar back

name: remove-after-rename
mirrors: Install.ts applyShim: move fs.remove(paths.originalAsar) after fs.rename(paths.shimAsar, paths.originalAsar), so it deletes the fresh original

name: shim-before-unpacked
mirrors: Install.ts applyShim: rename the shim into app.asar before copying app.asar.unpacked to _app.asar.unpacked
edits:
/\ app' = Shim
    /\ Finish
    /\ app' = Shim
    /\ IF current = "original"
       THEN pc' = "a_copy" /\ UNCHANGED <<current, hadOrig, lastStop>>
       ELSE Finish

/\ origUnp' = unp
    /\ pc' = "a_renameShim"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<app, unp, orig, installed, current, hadOrig, faults, lastStop>>

/\ origUnp' = unp
    /\ Finish
    /\ UNCHANGED <<app, unp, orig, installed, faults>>
